main.description: A public text post. Corrections, supplements, and endorsements are represented as new posts with extensions.

text.description: Human-readable text that remains useful without extension support. Do not normalize Unicode or line endings after signing.

createdAt.description: The post creation time. This protocol requires UTC with an uppercase Z suffix and preserves the original string representation, including fractional seconds.

deliveryExpiresAt.description: The author-specified absolute deadline for mesh delivery, distinct from information validity and deletion. This protocol requires UTC with an uppercase Z suffix.

extensions.description: Optional author-signed extensions. Preserve each element's $type and unknown fields, array order, and multiple elements of the same type. Use an empty array when no extensions are present.
